Each tutorial is a set of chapters with definitions, theorems, worked examples and exercises with solutions. They are
meant to be read in this order: the mathematics for physicists, then theoretical physics, then Kaluza-Klein theories,
and separately the mathematics for machine learning alongside machine learning.
